Confirming the cancellation on our end. We're sorry Wrenfield didn't end up being the right fit for Maple Media -- the door's open if that changes.

Chidi Haddad

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Maple Media set up
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project or key milestone despite onboarding email [email:9c7245b3]; no reply from Zara and no tickets, so engagement is unclear. One invite sent shows some intent, but with 8 days left and no project yet, unaided activation looks unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Maple Media's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Nice work getting an invite out already — that's a good first step. The other half is creating a first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so your team has somewhere to work once they join. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to start there.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Chidi
